'''Mikalu''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Sunsokua]], a [[Mahea|Mahean]] economy and the eleventh-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city had a population of 8,430,000 at the [[Sunsokua|Sunsokuan]] 1764 census, ranking it the [[List of cities and dependencies by population|forty-ninth-largest city in the world]] by population. Mikalu is the political, financial and cultural centre of [[Sunsokua]].
